_readme: Real Pune cinemas shown in CineBook. Source of truth for cinema names and locations. Names are those used on public booking listings (District, researched 2026-11-20); coordinates come from OpenStreetMap's Nominatim geocoder (location_precision 'building' = the mall or building itself, 'area' = only the road or neighbourhood). 'screens' and 'formats' are null/empty unless known: showtimes, prices and seat maps are CineBook demo data. District lists 21 cinemas; 'Cinepolis VIP Seasons Mall' is the premium section of Cinépolis Seasons Mall and is merged into it. To add a cinema, append an entry; to remove one, delete it; then run .\scripts\import-cinemas.ps1.
